description: KL-85 is the Sub-Regional Transport Office (SRTO) for Ramanattukara, established to manage vehicle registration and licensing services for the southern region of the Kozhikode district. The office serves as a decentralized hub of the Kerala Motor Vehicles Department, reducing the administrative burden on the main Kozhikode RTO (KL-11). It primarily caters to the growing urban populations of Ramanattukara and Feroke.
address: Sub Regional Transport Office, Imax Tower, Chungam, Feroke P.O., Kozhikode, Kerala
